description: Known cross-platform drift for ios (A9.2: recorded, not changed, in this program). `expectations` maps each expectations file (by name) and case file to text that names every field that differs, as "field: why". A conformance test passes a case when ios matches `expected`, or differs only in a field its entry names; the entry is removed in the change that fixes the drift. `other` records verified drift no expectations case pins. Only the ios unit edits this file.

other.bannerSizes.lineBreak: A BANNER_SIZES size text with a line break around a part, such as "320x50\n" (one text, or a list entry), is dropped and reported as config.banner_sizes.invalid: SellwildAdSizes trims each part of spaces only (.whitespaces), as it always has. The app-config schema size pattern allows it (\s*) and Android trims each part fully and keeps the size. No expectations case pins it; SellwildAdSizesTests.testSizeTextWithALineBreakIsDroppedAsBefore does.
other.bannerSizes.tooLargeForAnInt: A BANNER_SIZES size with a part of 2^63 or more (the schema allows any run of digits, such as "99999999999999999999x50") or a pair part that reads as infinity ("inf") is dropped and reported as config.banner_sizes.invalid. Before phase 3 round 2 it crashed the app (`Int(_:)` traps in the de-duplication key). Android keeps such a size, saturated to Int.MAX_VALUE by `toInt()`. SellwildAdSizesTests.testSizeTooLargeForAnIntIsDroppedNotACrash pins it.
other.growthcode.atypeTooLargeForAnInt: An eid uid atype of 2^63 or more (the eid-blob schema allows any run of digits) reads as Int.max; before phase 3 round 2 it crashed the app (`Int(_:)` traps). Core keeps the JavaScript number. Text that reads as infinity or NaN reads as 0, as in core. SellwildGrowthCodeTests.testAtypeTooLargeForAnIntIsNotACrash pins it.
other.bannerSizes.pairTextPadding: A BANNER_SIZES pair whose part is text with spaces or line breaks around it, such as [" 320 ", "50"], is dropped and reported as config.banner_sizes.invalid: SellwildAdSizes reads a text part with Double(_:), which does not trim, as it always has. The app-config schema allows any text in a pair, and Android (org.json optDouble, which trims) keeps the size. No expectations case pins it; SellwildAdSizesTests.testPairTextWithSpacesIsDroppedAsBefore does.
other.localized.frequencyText: LOCALIZED_LISTINGS.frequency as numeric text with spaces around it, such as " 12.5 " (contracts/fixtures/localized-listings-config/valid/frequency-text.json; the schema pattern allows the spaces), reads as 0 on iOS, so the dispersion is off, with no report: SellwildLocalizedListings reads text with Double(_:), which does not trim, as it always has. Core reads 12.5. Two related differences: a frequency that is set but is not a number (a list, true) reads as 0 with no report on iOS, where core reports localized.config.invalid; and iOS truncates a fractional frequency to a whole percent before the every-Nth math (66.7 reads as 66, every 2nd slot), where core rounds 100/66.7 (every slot). SellwildLocalizedListingsTests.testFrequencyTextFixtureWithSpacesReadsAsZero and testFrequencyNumbersOfEveryWidth pin it.
other.growthcode.ttlTextPadding: GROWTHCODE_TTL_HOURS as numeric text with spaces or a line break around it, such as " 12 " (the schema allows any text), reads as unset on iOS: the 48-hour default, with no report, because SellwildGrowthCode reads text with Double(_:), which does not trim, as it always has. Core reads 12. Neither reports a TTL that is not a number. SellwildGrowthCodeTests.testTtlTextWithSpacesReadsAsTheDefault pins it.
other.bridge.adImpressionNumberZone: A widget AD_IMPRESSION bridge message whose zoneId is a number (contracts/fixtures/bridge-message/valid/ad-impression-number-zone.json; the schema allows string or number) reaches the delegate with zoneId "" on iOS: SellwildWidgetPage.parse reads zoneId with `as? String`, as SellwildWidgetView always did. Android (optString) gives "43". It is not reported, since the message is valid. SellwildWidgetPageTests.testEveryValidMessageParsesWithoutAProblem pins it.
